GrowingBadEffectDesc_0.en: The host's weapon attack hit rate against enemies is further decreased.
GrowingBadEffectDesc_0.cn: 宿主的兵器攻击命中敌人的几率额外降低。
GrowingBadEffectDesc_0.ru: Скорость попадания при Атаке Оружием хозяина по врагам еще больше снижается.

GrowingBadEffectDesc_1.en: Inflicts minor Daze damage on the host whenever the host's poison takes effect, scaling with the Gu's remaining duration.
GrowingBadEffectDesc_1.cn: 宿主毒性发作时根据蛊虫的剩余持续时间给宿主施加少量失神伤害。

GrowingBadEffectDesc_2.en: The level of the host's Opening and Sealed Acupoint increases by 1.
GrowingBadEffectDesc_2.cn: 宿主受到的破绽、封穴级别增加1级
GrowingBadEffectDesc_2.ru: Уровень раскрытия и запечатывания Акупунктурной точки хозяина увеличивается на 1.

GrowingBadEffectDesc_3.en: When the host's True Qi decreases, it randomly causes another type of True Qi in the host to decrease by 2.
GrowingBadEffectDesc_3.cn: 宿主的真气减少时，使宿主随机类型的真气再减少2点。

GrowingBadEffectDesc_4.en: If the host's Health is not below 50%, the Wound Damage received by the host is additionally increased. And the more the Wound Damage is increased, the more the host's Health will decrease.
GrowingBadEffectDesc_4.cn: 如果宿主的健康不低于50%，宿主受到的重创伤害额外提高，且被提高的重创伤害越多，宿主的健康也会减少越多。

GrowingBadEffectDesc_5.en: The chance of the host's Martial Arts and weapons being sealed further increases.
GrowingBadEffectDesc_5.cn: 宿主的功法、兵器被封禁的几率额外提高。
GrowingBadEffectDesc_5.ru: Вероятность того, что Боевые искусства и Оружие хозяина будут запечатаны, еще больше возрастает.

GrowingBadEffectDesc_6.en: The Pure Essence Suppression from Pure Essence effects granted to the host by Body Purification, Spirit Fullness, and Transcendent Realm are decreased.
GrowingBadEffectDesc_6.cn: 宿主由洗浊、神足、入化赋予的精纯境界效果中的精纯压制效果降低。

GrowingBadEffectDesc_7.en: The host's positive "traits" will temporarily change their positive effects on all of the host's Primary Attributes, Secondary traits, Hit, Deflect, Attack, Defense, and Talent into negative ones.
GrowingBadEffectDesc_7.cn: 宿主的正面「特性」对宿主的所有主要属性、次要属性、命中、化解、攻击、防御、资质的正面影响会暂时变化为负面影响。

GrowingGoodEffectDesc_0.en: The host's weapon attack hit rate against enemies is further increased.
GrowingGoodEffectDesc_0.cn: 宿主的兵器攻击命中敌人的几率额外提高。
GrowingGoodEffectDesc_0.ru: Скорость Атаки Оружием хозяина по врагам еще больше увеличивается.

GrowingGoodEffectDesc_1.en: Inflicts minor Daze damage on the enemy whenever the host's poison takes effect, scaling with the Gu's remaining duration.
GrowingGoodEffectDesc_1.cn: 宿主毒性发作时根据蛊虫的剩余持续时间给敌人施加少量失神伤害。

GrowingGoodEffectDesc_2.en: The level of the host's Opening and Sealed Acupoint decreases by 1.
GrowingGoodEffectDesc_2.cn: 宿主受到的破绽、封穴级别减少1级
GrowingGoodEffectDesc_2.ru: Уровень раскрытия и запечатанной Акупунктурной точки хозяина уменьшается на 1.

GrowingGoodEffectDesc_3.en: When the host's True Qi increases, it randomly causes another type of True Qi in the host to increase by 2.
GrowingGoodEffectDesc_3.cn: 宿主的真气增加时，使宿主随机类型的真气再增加2点。

GrowingGoodEffectDesc_4.en: If the host's Health is not below 50%, the Wound Damage received by the host is additionally decreased. And the more the Wound Damage is decreased, the more the host's Health will increase.
GrowingGoodEffectDesc_4.cn: 如果宿主的健康不低于50%，宿主受到的重创伤害额外降低，但被降低的重创伤害越多，宿主的健康也会减少越多。

GrowingGoodEffectDesc_5.en: The chance of the host's Martial Arts and weapons being sealed further decreases.
GrowingGoodEffectDesc_5.cn: 宿主的功法、兵器被封禁的几率额外降低。
GrowingGoodEffectDesc_5.ru: Вероятность того, что Боевые искусства и Оружие хозяина будут запечатаны, еще больше уменьшается.

GrowingGoodEffectDesc_6.en: The Pure Essence Suppression from Pure Essence effects granted to the host by Body Purification, Spirit Fullness, and Transcendent Realm are increased.
GrowingGoodEffectDesc_6.cn: 宿主由洗浊、神足、入化赋予的精纯境界效果中的精纯压制效果提高。

GrowingGoodEffectDesc_7.en: The host's negative "traits" will temporarily change their negative effects on all of the host's Primary Attributes, Secondary traits, Hit, Defuse, Attack, Deflect, and Talent into positive ones.
GrowingGoodEffectDesc_7.cn: 宿主的负面「特性」对宿主的所有主要属性、次要属性、命中、化解、攻击、防御、资质的负面影响会暂时变化为正面影响。

GrownEffectDesc_0.en: The host will lose some items during the change of months.
GrownEffectDesc_0.cn: 宿主在月份更替时会遗失部分物品。
GrownEffectDesc_0.ru: Хозяин потеряет некоторые предметы во время смены месяцев.

GrownEffectDesc_1.en: During the change of months, the host will inexplicably become vindictive against those whose Favorability has greatly decreased and will more readily seek revenge on foes.
GrownEffectDesc_1.cn: 宿主在月份更替时还会无端的仇视那些与其好感大幅下降的人物，并更容易向仇人寻仇。

GrownEffectDesc_2.en: The host will suffer from Inner Breath Chaos during the change of months due to the injury level.
GrownEffectDesc_2.cn: 宿主的内息在月份更替时会因身上的伤势程度而紊乱。
GrownEffectDesc_2.ru: Хозяин будет страдать от хаоса Внутреннего дыхания во время смены месяцев из-за уровня Травмы.

GrownEffectDesc_3.en: During the change of months, the host's Mania or Deviation multiplies tenfold.
GrownEffectDesc_3.cn: 宿主在月份更替时的入邪、入魔程度的增加量变为10倍。
GrownEffectDesc_3.ru: При смене месяцев мания или Искажение хозяина усиливается в десять раз.

GrownEffectDesc_4.en: The host's Health cannot be restored during the change of months due to the state of Inner Breath.
GrownEffectDesc_4.cn: 宿主的健康无法在月份更替时因内息状况而得到恢复。
GrownEffectDesc_4.ru: Здоровье носителя не может быть восстановлено в течение смены месяцев из-за состояния Внутреннего дыхания.

GrownEffectDesc_5.en: The host's Qi cannot be restored during the change of months and will significantly deplete.
GrownEffectDesc_5.cn: 宿主的内力无法在月份更替时恢复，并会大量流失。
GrownEffectDesc_5.ru: Ци хозяина не может быть восстановлена в течение смены месяцев и значительно истощится.

GrownEffectDesc_6.en: During the change of months, the Prime Aureate Gu will randomly devour one of the host's developed Gu and inflict a large amount of toxin on the host.
GrownEffectDesc_6.cn: 金蚕王蛊在月份更替时还会随机吞噬宿主体内的1个成蛊，并向宿主施加大量的毒素。

GrownEffectDesc_7.en: Any individual who makes intimate contact with the host will be inflicted with an un-attuned Prismatic Gu Larva.
GrownEffectDesc_7.cn: 与宿主肌肤相亲的所有人物都会被种下未识主的青髓若蛊。

MakeTip_0.en: It will inevitably occur when <SpName=sp_icon_poison_3><color=#redpoison>Pyrotoxin</color> exceeds 40% of poison consumption.
MakeTip_0.cn: <SpName=sp_icon_poison_3><color=#redpoison>赤毒</color>超过毒素消耗的四成时必然诞生

MakeTip_1.en: It will inevitably occur when <SpName=sp_icon_poison_1><color=#gloomypoison>Umbritoxin</color> exceeds 40% of poison consumption.
MakeTip_1.cn: <SpName=sp_icon_poison_1><color=#gloomypoison>郁毒</color>超过毒素消耗的四成时必然诞生

MakeTip_2.en: It will inevitably occur when <SpName=sp_icon_poison_4><color=#rottenpoison>Necrotoxin</color> exceeds 40% of poison consumption.
MakeTip_2.cn: <SpName=sp_icon_poison_4><color=#rottenpoison>腐毒</color>超过毒素消耗的四成时必然诞生

MakeTip_3.en: It will inevitably occur when the consumption of all types of Toxins differs by less than 10%.
MakeTip_3.cn: 所有类型毒素消耗相差不足一成时必然诞生
MakeTip_3.ru: Это неизбежно произойдет, когда потребление всех видов токсинов будет отличаться менее чем на 10%.

MakeTip_4.en: It will inevitably occur when <SpName=sp_icon_poison_0><color=#hotpoison>Acritoxin</color>, <SpName=sp_icon_poison_3><color=#redpoison>Pyrotoxin</color>, and <SpName=sp_icon_poison_4><color=#rottenpoison>Necrotoxin</color> each exceed 30% of poison consumption.
MakeTip_4.cn: 当<SpName=sp_icon_poison_0><color=#hotpoison>烈毒</color><SpName=sp_icon_poison_3><color=#redpoison>赤毒</color><SpName=sp_icon_poison_4><color=#rottenpoison>腐毒</color>均超过毒素消耗的三成时必然诞生

MakeTip_5.en: It will inevitably occur when <SpName=sp_icon_poison_2><color=#coldpoison>Cryotoxin</color> exceeds 40% of poison consumption.
MakeTip_5.cn: <SpName=sp_icon_poison_2><color=#coldpoison>寒毒</color>超过毒素消耗的四成时必然诞生

MakeTip_6.en: It will inevitably occur when <SpName=sp_icon_poison_0><color=#hotpoison>Acritoxin</color> exceeds 40% of poison consumption.
MakeTip_6.cn: <SpName=sp_icon_poison_0><color=#hotpoison>烈毒</color>超过毒素消耗的四成时必然诞生

MakeTip_7.en: It will inevitably occur when <SpName=sp_icon_poison_1><color=#gloomypoison>Umbritoxin</color>, <SpName=sp_icon_poison_2><color=#coldpoison>Cryotoxin</color>, <SpName=sp_icon_poison_5><color=#illusorypoison>Oneirotoxin</color> each exceed 30% of poison consumption.
MakeTip_7.cn: 当<SpName=sp_icon_poison_1><color=#gloomypoison>郁毒</color><SpName=sp_icon_poison_2><color=#coldpoison>寒毒</color><SpName=sp_icon_poison_5><color=#illusorypoison>幻毒</color>均超过毒素消耗的三成时必然诞生
